texts.zh:
对[from.GetName]的极端地质应力进行深入研究之后，我们发现了一座巨大的超级火山因上部火山锥的部分崩塌而被堵塞。

大量滞留的熔岩已经灌满了所有能联通的底下空间，正在对主通喷口的堵塞物施加巨大的向上压力。坍塌物暂时将岩浆禁锢在原地，但谁也不知道这种微妙的平衡还能持续多久。

被锁住的熔岩含有异常多的稀有金属和多种矿物质。[leader.GetName]相信我们帮助它可控喷发之后就可以收获这些资源了。
texts.en:
After further study of the extreme seismic tension on [from.GetName], we have discovered that a colossal supervolcano has become blocked by a partial upper cone collapse.

Vast reserves of magma have filled all available underground chambers and are exerting immense upward pressure against the blockage in the main vent. The collapsed material is currently holding the magma in place, but it is impossible to predict how long this delicate equilibrium will last.

The trapped molten rock is exceptionally rich in rare metals and complex mineral compounds. [leader.GetName] believes we can harvest these resources safely by facilitating a controlled eruption.

label.zh: 充分利用这种地质活动。
label.en: Put the geothermal activity to good use.

texts.en: A blocked supervolcano on [from.GetName] is holding vast reserves of mineral-rich magma below the surface. Conducting a controlled eruption would allow us to harvest these trapped resources.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.From.GetName]的超级火山外锥体上的不同位置挖了一系列人工竖井，将其结构削弱，使其无法继续约束下方大量堆积的岩浆。

一越过临界点就会产生惊人的结果。高压的熔岩向上爆炸，摧毁了整座火山的上半部分。

我们将溢出的熔岩引导到精心准备的通道中，以专门的采矿设备进行收集。
texts.en:
By boring a series of artificial shafts at various points in the outer cone of [from.From.GetName]'s supervolcano, we weakened its structure until it was no longer able to contain the massive accumulation of magma below.

Once the tipping point was reached, the results were spectacular. The volcano's upper section was obliterated entirely as highly pressured molten rock exploded upward.

We directed the overflowing lava into carefully prepared channels, where it will be harvested by specialized mining equipment.

summary.text:
# 极端地质应力 / Extreme Geological Tension

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:475; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1338 (extreme_frontiers.290); common/special_projects/05_projects_extreme_frontiers.txt (CONTROLLED_ERUPTION_PROJECT); events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:1373 (extreme_frontiers.295)

## 如何开始 How it starts

熔岩星球可能生成（3级，权重3；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a molten planet (level 3, weight 3; needs has_shroud_dlc).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.290“受阻超级火山”：选项a启用项目 CONTROLLED_ERUPTION_PROJECT“受控喷发”（90天，限时720天）；选项b直接获得每月能量加成。项目完成后 extreme_frontiers.295“史诗级喷发”：d_minerals_3 矿藏、每月矿物加成并推进采矿科技。

Single result extreme_frontiers.290 "Blocked Supervolcano": option a enables project CONTROLLED_ERUPTION_PROJECT (90 days, time limit 720 days); option b takes a monthly energy bonus instead. Completion fires extreme_frontiers.295 "Mega Eruption": a d_minerals_3 deposit, monthly minerals and progress on mining techs.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

290 的选项a/b二选一；只有选项a通向项目与 295，项目超过720天未完成则失效。

290's options a/b are alternatives; only a leads to the project and 295, which expires if not finished within 720 days.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

295 的选项文字对机械帝国有变体。

295's option text has a machine-empire variant.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义、项目与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition, the project and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
